features: Super-Sized Screen, Portable Design: Capsule 3 is an all-new ultra-portable Google TV projector licensed by Netflix.
Take the Big Screen Anywhere: With a max screen size of 120 inches, Capsule 3 delivers a cinema-level experience you can take with you anywhere.
Next-Level Image Quality: The 1080p display with 200 Lumens of brightness makes movies shine for an immersive watching experience.
Long Playtime: Finish a whole 2.5-hour movie or listen to 8 hours of music on a single charge. (under eco mode)

sections.title: Control remoto inteligente SofaBaton
content: El Control remoto inteligente SofaBaton destaca por su integración completa con tu sistema de entretenimiento. Controla más de 500,000 dispositivos con un solo mando, gracias a su compatibilidad de IR, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi y RF. Su pantalla táctil te permite acceder instantáneamente a tus canales favoritos y controlar actividades como "Noche de Película" o "Tiempo de Juego" con un simple toque.
Su precio actual en Amazon ronda los... 360 dólares. ¡Link en el primer comentario!
visuals: Product image: Control remoto inteligente SofaBaton
features: 【THE PERFECT UPGRADE】This X2 universal remote is designed to replace all your old remotes including IR, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and RF compatible devices. With support for 6,000+ brands and 500,000+ devices, it’s the ultimate all-in-one solution for your home entertainment system. Our regularly updated database ensures compatibility with the latest gadgets.

【COMPLETE HOME ASSISTANT INTEGRATION】Offers seamless smart home management by allowing you to add the dedicated Sofabaton Hub integration into your Home Assistant system, enabling HA automations to directly execute your pre-set Activities. For complete control, you can also add commands in our Sofabaton app to control Home Assistant-connected devices, establishing a robust, bi-directional link that ensures harmonious, cross-platform control between your entertainment devices and your entire smart home ecosystem.

【INSTANT CHANNEL ACCESS】Tired of Endless Menu Scrolling? The X2 Universal Remote with touchscreen and convenient charging dock makes everything simple! As the first smart remote with a quick-access touch screen, it features a dedicated button for instant access to the numeric keypad (0-9), favorite keys, and macros. It's smarter and faster than any standard smart remote.

【ONE-TOUCH ACTIVITIES】Turn on custom activities like "Movie Night" or "Game Time" with a single tap! Launch multiple commands at once to turn on your TV, switch inputs, adjust sound, and dim lights—all without manually adjusting each device. Simply touch the screen to activate your ideal setup instantly.

【HANDS-FREE VOICE CONTROL】The X2 universal remote control offers full compatibility with Alexa and Google Assistant. Simply link your SofaBaton account to integrate all your activities. Use voice commands like, "Alexa, turn on Movie Night" to instantly activate your customized scenes—no remote needed. Experience voice-activated entertainment throughout your home.
